title: It’s just a scam
body: You have to sign up for a subscription before you can try the app.
author: Angela-12-

title: Just a black screen
body:
Since the latest iOS update, opening the app results in just a black screen. (The app is up to date, according to the App Store, and I’ve power-cycled the phone.)

My previous review:

Thrilled to have it back

This was my favourite routine scheduling app for years. I’m very excited to have it back. There are a few features I miss from the old version of the app, maybe just because I’m a creature of habit, and this version is still better than anything else out there.
author: Essentiae

title: So not free??
body: Was excited to use this just to find out that I can’t because it’s not free??
